title: An Analysis of Figurative Language in Laurie Halse Anderson’s Wintergirls
core_idea: Examine the use of figurative language in the novel Wintergirls by identifying and classifying types of figurative devices and analyzing their semantic functions using Leech’s (1981) seven types of meaning, based on systematic random sampling of chapters and coded textual excerpts.
tldr: Study identifies and classifies figurative language in Wintergirls and analyzes its semantic functions via Leech’s seven types of meaning using systematic random sampling and coded excerpts.
